rawIdea: HomeBase is a shared household management app that helps busy families organize their daily lives in one place. Family members can manage chores, shared grocery lists, household expenses, appointments, schedules, and rewards. Parents can assign one-time or recurring chores, set deadlines, track completion, and create rewards. Children have a simple view where they can see responsibilities, complete tasks, track progress, and view earned rewards. The app includes a family dashboard showing what needs attention today, upcoming appointments, overdue tasks, grocery needs, and recent household activity.
